title: CrownmarkResonanceSchema
description: Validation schema for commander set resonance matching, tactical bonuses, and custom pixel shader parameters.

heroes_resonance.description: Mapping of individual hero resonance sets indexed by hero ID.

set_name.description: The unique localized name for the 5-piece matching equipment set.

aura_visual_style.description: Standard identification key for aura particle effects (e.g. celestial_glow).

halo_unlocked_tier.description: The minimum tier level required to render a floating halo.

overdrive_particle_count.description: Count limits for customized active GPU particle emitters in Godot 4.

portrait_shader_override.description: GDScript standard absolute path to the .gdshader script.

tiers.description: Equipment count tiers (2, 3, 4, 5 pieces required) and their modifiers.

count_required.description: Total pieces from the same signature group that must be equipped.

name.description: The name of the tier's active blessing.

description.description: Detailed description of the passive skill or combat behavior.

stat_modifiers.description: Key-value dictionary of numeric stat multipliers or adjustments applied on activation.
